//: SwayNC notification center. The look lives in style.css next to it.
//1: This file overrides /etc/xdg/swaync/config.json - keys that are
//2: not here are taken from that system file.
//pozycja: Notifications and the panel slide out from the top right corner,
//pozycja2: i.e. from under the bell button in Waybar.
//warstwa: Bubbles on the overlay layer - they must be visible even above
//warstwa2: a fullscreen window. The panel itself on the top layer, so that it
//warstwa3: does not cover the dock and the bar when someone leaves it open.
//odstep: Panel offset from the top and right edges. 50 px at the top
//odstep2: is 6 px of bar margin + 38 px of bar height + 6 px of slack,
//odstep3: so the panel starts right below the bar, not behind it.
//css: "user" means our style.css wins over the GTK theme.
//czasy: How many seconds a bubble stays up. Critical ones (timeout-critical: 0)
//czasy2: do not disappear on their own - you have to click them, and that is the point.
//widgety: Order of the blocks in the panel, top to bottom.
//widgety2: The 'mpris' widget was removed from here - the player now has
//widgety4: opened by clicking the track title on the bar or with SUPER+O.
//widgety5: Keeping both would mean two full players at once.
